race.comment: Former Victorian DRAW ATTENTION (6) just missed the frame when having the first run for the stable and will have come on with that run now under the belt. Will appreciate the step-up in trip now and must be respected out of the Gollan barn. Capable of playing a major role in the outcome. TULONG (4) has placed around this circuit and will be at peak fitness for this fifth run back. Include in calculations. BILLS ANGEL (9) broke the maiden status over this track and trip last time out and will have derived a stack of confidence from that victory. Can go back-to-back. SHEDRIVESABENTLEY (14) doesn't win out of turn but is usually thereabouts and gets in light with the claim. One for the multiples.
